theme: An open day, with the trip clock ticking.
greeting: A clear calendar today, Dan — no meetings from now until tomorrow. The pressure that's building is quieter: a run of Croatia bookings has slipped past due, and Mike's Sunday review lands at nine tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: On your calendar tomorrow at nine — the 15-minute board triage. Worth arriving having put an owner and a date on the open travel items so nothing slips a fourth Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings past due
needsAttention.detail: Three P1 tasks are overdue and all hit a wall on Sept 8, when you fly: the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer, the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap, and getting checked bags confirmed in writing on the ticket. The charter has no connectivity, so these have to be settled from dry land.

flagged.title: Nautilus charter balance due
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks invoice for Nautilus Sailing shows a balance due with payment unfinished — worth closing before the Sept 12 charter.

flagged.title: LinkedIn: connection + job alert
flagged.detail: Tim Soley accepted your connection, and a saved search surfaced a Microsoft regional managing director role.

flagged.title: Care.com applicants waiting
flagged.detail: Several caregiver candidates applied to your posting and at least one is waiting to hear back.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Folio Society, Monocle, Bloomberg, Indochino, Nextdoor.

recipe.title: Squid with Chili and Clams
recipe.why: A bright, briny plate that leans on high summer's peak seafood and fresh chilies.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night + noon transfer
Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20–22 landing gap
Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket in writing
Book a refundable backup car, Sept 20–Oct 5 (TPA)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the first genuinely clear morning in a while.
An open stretch, the kind that's easy to lose if nothing claims it.
Tomorrow opens early with the 15-minute Sunday review with Mike at nine.
